items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I knew Ella Fitzgerald as a babe. She was only 15 years old.

ctx.x: Do you remember anybody else in that band?

Yeah, there was Sandy Williams. Did Sandy play with Chick? Walter Johnson on the drums. No, not Walter Johnson - Chick was on his own drums then. Ella Fitzgerald singing. I can't remember. What's his name - Elmer Williams - he's dead. He played saxophone. Who else do I remember in that band?
